title: SeaDream Handmade Ceramic Fish

title: Soul Ceramics Little Penguin Figurine
description: A Living Fairy Tale by Soul Ceramics A LIVING FAIRY TALE ABOUT A LITTLE PENGUIN WHO DIDN’T KNOW WHAT HE WAS BORN FOR The little Penguin wasn’t born like ordinary penguins. He hadn’t hatched from an egg. And he had no parents who had kept an egg warm until a tiny baby emerged from it. He was born from FIRE. Very hot fire. The little Penguin lived on a warm wooden shelf, alongside others just like him — little creatures born from fire: a little Owl, a Bear, a Hedgehog, and many other adorable little ones. It was warm and cozy there. But one day, the Penguin overheard a story about penguins living in Antarctica, a place filled with ice and snow. He began asking his neighbors what this ice and snow actually were. But not one of them had ever even heard of such things. He searched for ice in the nearby mugs standing on the shelf, peered into every bowl, and even looked inside the sugar jar. But there was no ice and no snow anywhere. The truth was, he didn’t even really know what he was looking for. At last, he quietly sat down on the edge of the wooden shelf and let out a heavy sigh. And just at that moment, a pair of warm hands gently lifted him up. “Oh, aren’t you just adorable…” The little Penguin didn’t say a word. He only felt how warm and cozy he was in those hands. And suddenly, he understood something very important. Not every penguin has to live where there is ice and snow. Some are born to bring warmth to people. About this little character Meet an adorable handmade ceramic penguin figurine, lovingly created in my Soul Ceramics studio. With his soft sandy-colored body, black-and-white face, tiny shiny feet, and wonderfully earnest expression, this little fellow has a personality all his own. He is a one-of-a-kind ceramic creation, shaped and finished by hand. Small details and subtle variations make him truly unique. More than just a decorative figurine, he is a little character with a story waiting to unfold — and perhaps a new home where his own fairy tale can begin. A thoughtful gift for penguin lovers, ceramic art collectors, animal figurine enthusiasts, or anyone who appreciates handmade treasures with a heart. Soul Ceramics — handmade pottery with a little magic in every piece.

title: Wabi-Sabi Handmade Ceramic Cezve
description: A Little Piece of Nature in Your Coffee Ritual Some things are made to be used. Others are made to bring a little magic into everyday life. This one-of-a-kind ceramic Turkish coffee pot is entirely handmade in the spirit of wabi-sabi, celebrating the natural beauty of imperfection, organic shapes, and the unique character of handmade objects. Its softly rounded body features a cheerful little green lizard on one side and a colorful snail on the other. The long handle is made from a genuine pine branch, preserving its natural shape and rustic character. No two branches are alike, and neither are handmade ceramic pieces. The interior is finished using a traditional Slavic milk-firing technique, an old method of treating pottery with milk rather than glaze. This gives the piece its distinctive, natural finish and reflects my love of traditional ceramic techniques. Imagine a quiet morning, the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, and a handmade pot that feels as though it belongs in a little house in the woods. Traditional Milk-Fired Interior The unglazed, milk-treated interior is a deliberate choice based on my experience making more than twenty ceramic coffee pots from different types of clay. In my experience, similar pots with milk-treated, unglazed interiors have performed better during coffee preparation on a gas stove than glazed versions, which developed cracks. The ceramic body was fired at 1080°C before the natural pine branch handle was attached. My personal experience with three other pots of this kind has been positive. However, this particular piece has not been individually tested over a flame, so its performance under direct heat cannot be guaranteed. Details * One-of-a-kind handmade ceramic Turkish coffee pot (cezve) * Wabi-sabi-inspired organic shape * Genuine natural pine branch handle * Handcrafted lizard and snail decorations * Unglazed interior treated using the traditional milk-firing technique * Ceramic body fired at 1080°C * Individually handmade by Lika Val, creator of Soul Ceramics Every piece has its own character, with natural variations in shape, texture, and finish. A Gift with a Story A thoughtful gift for coffee lovers, pottery collectors, nature enthusiasts, and anyone who appreciates rustic, artistic objects with a story of their own. More than a coffee pot, this is a little meeting of clay, wood, nature, and traditional craftsmanship. Handmade with care by Lika Val, Soul Ceramics. Care and Use Ceramic cookware can be sensitive to sudden temperature changes. Gradual heating and cooling are essential to help reduce the risk of thermal shock. Because this particular piece has not been individually tested over a flame, safe use on a gas stove cannot be guaranteed. The natural branch handle must be kept away from direct flame and excessive heat.
